name: Review standards applicability, validated check records, verifier commit observations, warn/block gate, and brief rules
summary: Applicable rules for a contribution are derived from trusted changed paths (serving_repos.<pid> merge-base diff with --no-renames or independent verifier commit observations; never author-supplied base_commit or file lists, falling back to diff_unverified) plus task labels and kinds, and are projected into worker and reviewer briefs. Judgement pass check records require server-validated file:line citations against regular text blobs in the commit tree (inspected outside the project lock from the self-contained verified bundle under a bounded O_NOFOLLOW fetch lock, serving_repo, or verifier tree_files) or command+exit_code evidence; fail cites a review item_id; mechanical rules read verifier-recorded CI observations (unverified when absent, refusing reviewer pass). Standalone verify credentials stamp their issuing person's party and enforce author/assignee/reviewer/approver independence. The per-project warn/block gate defaults to warn (recording would_have_refused without blocking) and fails closed in block mode (or when gate.json is damaged).
